description: cross-cylinders-common at ψ = 60°: the tool's axis in the xz plane through the origin, turned about itself so its seam is generic. The common is 16R³/(3 sin ψ) with area 16R²/sin ψ; the two section ellipses have major radii R/sin(ψ/2) and R/cos(ψ/2) and still cross at (0, ±R, 0), the section vertex no edge made (plans/cylinder-cylinder-booleans step 2)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE also cuts the section arc that runs through the second ellipse's parameter origin there, one more vertex and edge; Arris's edge range crosses the period once (E1) and the arc is one edge between the paves the seams and the crossing vertices make
